dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine-nginx:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG GRAV_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="TheSpad"

RUN \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    busybox-suid \
    nginx-mod-http-brotli \
    php85-dom \
    php85-gd \
    php85-intl \
    php85-ldap \
    php85-pdo \
    php85-pdo_sqlite \
    php85-pecl-apcu \
    php85-pecl-yaml \
    php85-redis \
    php85-tokenizer && \
  echo "**** configure php-fpm to pass env vars ****" && \
  sed -E -i 's/^;?clear_env ?=.*$/clear_env = no/g' /etc/php85/php-fpm.d/www.conf && \
  grep -qxF 'clear_env = no' /etc/php85/php-fpm.d/www.conf || echo 'clear_env = no' >> /etc/php85/php-fpm.d/www.conf && \
  echo "env[PATH] = /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" >> /etc/php85/php-fpm.conf && \
  echo "**** setup php opcache ****" && \
  { \
    echo 'opcache.memory_consumption=128'; \
    echo 'opcache.interned_strings_buffer=8'; \
    echo 'opcache.max_accelerated_files=4000'; \
    echo 'opcache.revalidate_freq=2'; \
    echo 'opcache.enable_cli=1'; \
  } > /etc/php85/conf.d/php-opcache.ini && \
  if [ -z ${GRAV_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    GRAV_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/getgrav/grav/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  echo "*** Installing Grav ***" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /app/www/public && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/grav.zip -L \
    "https://github.com/getgrav/grav/releases/download/${GRAV_RELEASE}/grav-admin-v${GRAV_RELEASE}.zip" && \
  unzip -q \
    /tmp/grav.zip -d /tmp/grav && \
  mv /tmp/grav/grav-admin/* /app/www/public/ && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    $HOME/.cache \
    $HOME/.composer

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 80 443

VOLUME /config

units.name: init-grav-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# Symlink directories
symlinks=(
    /app/www/public/backup
    /app/www/public/logs
    /app/www/public/user
)

shopt -s globstar dotglob

for i in "${symlinks[@]}"; do
    if [[ -d /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        rm -rf "$i"
    fi
    if [[ ! -d /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        mv "$i" /config/www/
    fi
    if [[ -d /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        ln -s /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" "$i"
    fi
done

# Symlink files
symlinks=(
    /app/www/public/robots.txt
)

shopt -s globstar dotglob

for i in "${symlinks[@]}"; do
    if [[ -f /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        rm -rf "$i"
    fi
    if [[ ! -f /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        mv "$i" /config/www/
    fi
    if [[ -f /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        ln -s /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" "$i"
    fi
done

shopt -u globstar dotglob

# permissions
lsiown -R abc:abc \
    /app \
    /config/www

notes.upstream: ### Improved - Added PHP 8.6 compatibility (while keeping PHP 8.3+ support): replaced deprecated `spl_object_hash()` calls with `spl_object_id()`, replaced `is_a()` on possible strings with `instanceof ArrayAccess`, guarded `parse_str()` and `Uri::pathExists()` against NUL-byte `ValueError` exceptions, handled `preg_grep()` and `Collator::asort()` error fallbacks, normalized `Page::taxonomy()` input before `array_walk()`, and cleaned up remaining PHP 8.5+ deprecations (`finfo_close()`, `Reflection*::setAccessible()`, `case ...;`, null array offset in `Job`, and `imagedestroy()` in tests) - Faster page rendering on large sites: navigation menus work out the current page's parents once per request instead of once per menu item, and `active()`/`activeChild()` and absolute URLs look up a single route instead of loading every route from the lazy page index - Sorting a collection no longer encodes every page's metadata as JSON to build its cache key, which took about 1 ms per sort on a 2,000-page blog - `dateRange` and `type`/`types` collection filters read page dates and templates from the page index instead of loading every page in the collection (20–25% faster on a 2,000-page blog) - The Redis and Memcached cache drivers share one connection per request instead of opening one for each cache - Smaller savings: linked CSS/JS pipeline bundles aren't read from disk on every request, the summary-divider regex only runs when the content has a divider, and `Collection::isFirst()`/`isLast()` no longer copy the item list ### Bugfix - A `media://` (or other stream) image in a folder whose name starts with a number, such as a `2022/09` upload folder, rendered with a broken `//media:2022//09/...` address. Images with resize or crop actions and HTML `` tags in content were affected too [#4417](https://github.com/getgrav/grav/issues/4417) - `Utils::replaceLastOccurrence()` no longer cuts in the wrong place when the text has multibyte characters before the match (`/blog/über-uns.json` came out as `/blog/über-uns.`) - `Uri::post()` with a filter no longer logs a PHP deprecation on every call. It compared against the deprecated `FILTER_SANITIZE_STRING` constant, which PHP 9 removes - Removed a call to `ArrayAdapter::setNamespace()`, which doesn't exist in Symfony Cache 7, from the `array` cache driver, plus a few smaller static-analysis cleanups - `Grav\Framework\Psr7\ServerRequest`, `Grav\Framework\Logger\Processors\UserProcessor` and `Grav\Framework\Cache\Adapter\SessionCache` load again. Their method signatures no longer matched PSR-7 2.0, Monolog 3 and Grav's cache base class, so PHP stopped with a fatal error on first use - The Flex relationship classes no longer log PHP deprecations when they load - `FlexIndex::findFirst()` and `reduce()` return a result instead of always returning `null` - `bin/gpm selfupgrade` no longer calls `strftime()`, which is deprecated and removed in PHP 9 - Removed the unused `Scheduler\SchedulerController` class, which pointed to a scheduler class that no longer exists, and the scheduler service's setup for a `scheduler.modern.enabled` option that called methods that were gone. The scheduler sets up its own queue, workers and history from `scheduler.modern` - Replaced deprecated library calls (Cron `factory()`, Monolog level constants, Doctrine `getOrderings()`, `utf8_encode()`) and removed compatibility branches for Twig 1/2 and PHP 7 that could no longer run, plus an unused Monolog 1/2 shim - Object collection filtering (`ObjectExpressionVisitor`) no longer extends Doctrine's `ClosureExpressionVisitor`, which Doctrine marks final and may lock in a future major version. It builds on Doctrine's abstract `ExpressionVisitor` and handles AND/OR/NOT itself, with the same results
